title: Laptop drive: remove the Secuura folders once Wednesday confirms the master copy holds them?
bluf: Tap a to confirm my plan. Measured just now on Laptop-DEV: the drive is 51% used (923 GB free, df), so it is not close to full. The Secuura material left here is about 610 MB: !CODING/Secuura holds Extranet (572 MB, 54,913 files), platform-s-main (33 MB), Pricing, Testing Harness and Agent, and Tokenomics, plus 158 vault notes. Blockchain was already removed on 15 October. No sync job writes Secuura here (the only unison profile, devnas, names no Laptop-DEV path). The biggest item on the drive is a 140 GB copy of Wednesday's own tree (/Volumes/Laptop-DEV/WEDNESDAY); I have asked her whether the laptop needs it. G-DRIVE and DevMASTER are not mounted here, so I cannot count the master copy myself; I have asked Wednesday for her per-folder counts.

options.label: Remove after Wednesday's counts match (recommended)
options.detail: Each folder is removed only after DevMASTER's file count matches mine; anything the master lacks goes to G-DRIVE first. The vault's Secuura notes are hidden from the laptop copy only (a sparse-checkout setting, no commit), so the master vault is untouched. A removal record is written like the 15 October one.

options.label: Remove now, without the master check
options.detail: Faster, but it repeats the 15 October risk: a folder that exists only here is lost.

options.label: Hold
options.detail: Nothing is removed. The drive has plenty of room today.

default_action: Nothing is removed until Wednesday's counts arrive; then option a runs. The 140 GB Wednesday copy is untouched until she and you say so.
_override_prior: matches share only the word tuesday (scheduler access, rotation, mini launch, vault commits, boot digest); his 18:21:50 message today orders the removal and this card asks only HOW (master count first), which no prior card rules
